purpose: The verified observability wiring posture of the @payswap/web public surface: what it emits, where events land per the runtime-activation record, the contract any future emission must follow, and the honest status of live sink verification.
law: spec/experience/DEPLOYMENT-TOPOLOGY.md section 4: observability is a vendor-neutral sink; every terminal-state transition, UNKNOWN outcome and reconciliation resolution is observable; request correlation via the response envelope requestId. The taxonomy (W3-007, @payswap/operations OBSERVABILITY_EVENT_TAXONOMY) owns the event vocabulary; alerts must reference runbook entries (no orphan alerts).

whatTheWebAppEmitsToday.finding: The public web surface (@payswap/web) emits NO independent telemetry of its own today — verified by source audit: no observability client, no sink URL, no event emission anywhere in packages/web/src (grep for observability/sink/taxonomy references: zero hits in application code). This is an honest recorded posture, not a gap being papered over.

signalsItDoesExpose.signal: GET /api/health — the liveness/readiness probe (hardened by this Work Order: dependency-bound checks, honest degraded reporting, never fake-healthy)
signalsItDoesExpose.consumer: any monitor / the rollback verification chain (scripts/deployment/web-rollback.mjs polls it and cross-checks build.id against the release records)
signalsItDoesExpose.contract: HTTP 200 = serving (ok or honestly degraded, body explains which); HTTP 503 = a CONFIGURED dependency failed; cache-control: no-store; body carries status/liveness/readiness/build/checkedAt

signalsItDoesExpose.signal: honest error surfacing in the rendered UI — every API fetch outcome is a discriminated union (unconfigured / network-error / http-error / ok) rendered verbatim (the api-client + cc/api-server doctrine); no fabricated success states
signalsItDoesExpose.consumer: the human user (and browser console remains error-free by acceptance law)
signalsItDoesExpose.contract: errors are surfaced, never swallowed or reinterpreted; UNKNOWN stays UNKNOWN

signalsItDoesExpose.signal: platform logs (Vercel function logs) — stdout/stderr of the deployment
signalsItDoesExpose.contract: platform-provided; no secret values are ever logged (the repo's secret hygiene law)

whereEventsLand.runtimePlaneSink: per spec/development-state/runtime-activation.json: the taxonomy-validated ingestion endpoint on the hosting plane (https://payswap-mu.vercel.app/api/internal/observability) validates events against the W3-007 taxonomy (rejecting non-taxonomy events — verified in the 2026-10-02 probe) and appends them to the Upstash stream payswap:observability:production
whereEventsLand.webAppRelationship: the web surface is a CONSUMER of the API runtime, NOT a writer to the observability stream: the sink is a runtime-plane binding (OBSERVABILITY_ENDPOINT belongs to the payswap API project's env, and the runtime-plane probe recorded it MISSING in the deployed web-api role env — runtime-plane-probe.json environmentCompleteness.deployed) — the boundary is deliberate: the web surface holds no financial state, so it has no terminal-state transitions, UNKNOWN outcomes or reconciliation resolutions of its own to emit (those are protocol-plane events owned by the runtime)
whereEventsLand.budgetNote: the sink stream payswap:observability:production carries a command/length budget in spec/development-state/upstash-budgets.json

emissionContract.law: IF the web surface ever needs to emit (e.g. web-plane deployment gate events), the ONLY sanctioned path is the runtime plane's taxonomy-validated ingestion endpoint with W3-007 taxonomy events carrying protocol correlation keys (requestId et al.) — NO parallel logging channel, NO bespoke vendor SDK, NO client-side telemetry (AGENTS.md rule 17: no provider lock-in; topology section 4: vendor-neutral sink)
steps: declare the event in @payswap/operations OBSERVABILITY_EVENT_TAXONOMY (W3-007 owns the vocabulary — a change there is a Work Order, not a drive-by)
emit server-side only, through the ingestion endpoint, with the required correlation keys
count the commands against spec/development-state/upstash-budgets.json (observability namespace budget)
wire the alert threshold to a runbook entry (no orphan alerts)

liveSinkVerification.detail: the operator vault (lost to the sandbox reset 2026-10-02) held the live bindings; the last LIVE sink verification on record is the runtime-plane activation probe (2026-10-02): 4 taxonomy events accepted with Upstash stream entry ids as receipts, and an invalid event correctly REJECTED (422) — evidence in spec/development-state/runtime-plane-probe.json observability section
liveSinkVerification.reverificationPath: re-run scripts/deployment/runtime-plane-probe.ts <release-sha> with the vault re-supplied (deploy:probe); for the web surface specifically, curl GET /api/health on the production alias (no credentials needed — public endpoint) and record the result in the next release record

healthEndpointNote: the /api/health probe hardened by this Work Order is itself an observability improvement: the rollback runbook's verification chain (health probe -> build.id -> release record -> commit) makes every production deployment's identity machine-checkable without any vendor telemetry.
